visual_enhancers.hud_scanlines: background: linear-gradient(rgba(18,16,16,0) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,0,0,0.03), rgba(0,255,0,0.01), rgba(0,0,255,0.03))

three_d_explainer_engine.primary_feature_rule: 3D visualization is the PRIMARY educational feature. It must be interactive, mathematically accurate, smooth, and accompanied by clean info panels.

solar_system.central_body: Sun with solar flare particle shader and dynamic bloom
solar_system.dwarf_planet: Pluto (Must NEVER be listed among the 8 primary planets, identified distinctly as Dwarf Planet when discussed)

details.Saturn: Includes detailed 3D ring system with orbital tilt
details.Orbital_Paths: Visible semi-transparent concentric orbital rings with label toggles

other_scientific_explaining.physics: Vector fields, pendulum mechanics, gravitational trajectories
other_scientific_explaining.chemistry: 3D molecular structures (e.g. H2O, Caffeine, Benzene ring) with rotatable bonds
other_scientific_explaining.biology: DNA Double Helix with base pair color coding

first_time_onboarding_flow: Step 1: PANDI AI MARK II title reveal with red plasma glow and official MP4 video background
Step 2: Ask user 'What should I call you?' text input with avatar upload option
Step 3: Play official PANDI AI introduction voice track (with skip/finish controls)
Step 4: Request Microphone permission for voice assistant mode
Step 5: Smooth entry to main PANDI Command Dashboard

general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attribute: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, modals, audio triggers, 3D controls, and chat elements MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='virtual-3d-button', data-testid='voice-mic-trigger', data-testid='planet-select-mars')
general_ui_ux_guidelines.responsiveness: Mobile-first layout with smooth WebXR/Canvas fallbacks on unsupported mobile browsers
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: High contrast text overlays on dark glass backgrounds, keyboard navigable 3D control shortcuts

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the primary interactive PANDI 3D Explainer Engine using Three.js / React Three Fiber seamlessly inside the React application.
Ensure exact compliance with the 8 planets rule (Mercury to Neptune) plus Earth's Moon and Saturn's rings.
Place the glowing central PANDI reactor face/helmet with circular animated pulse rings prominently in the interface.
Integrate live streaming text chat, dynamic server date anchoring, voice synthesis/recognition fallback, file drag-and-drop analysis, and conversation history.
Keep About modal showing: PANDI AI MARK II | Personalized Advanced Neural Digital Intelligence | Created by VIGNASHWAR S.
Ensure every single interactive element has a valid data-testid attribute.
